title: GUY2 Commands
description: Client-side mod that helps in normal survival world scenarios and on servers
body:
# **GUY2 Commands**

**GUY2 Commands** is a **quality-of-life client mod for Minecraft** that bundles everyday utilities, automations, and quick command workflows into one mod.

It's designed to **save time, reduce repetitive actions, and simplify common tasks** without requiring a large collection of separate mini-mods.

Inspired by **ClientCommands**, GUY2 Commands goes a step further by **automating in-game actions**, not just running commands.
For example, it can automatically **reroll villagers for specific enchants** or **execute commands directly from the inventory**.

Overall, it's a **personal-use automation mod focused on automating boring tasks.**

---

# **Main Menu (F6)**

Open the **F6 menu** to manage everything in one place:

* Toggle modules **on/off quickly**
* **Instantly search** for modules
* Use organized tabs:

  * **All**
  * **Toggles**
  * **Misc**
  * **Configs**
* **Right-click modules** to open configuration screens (when available)

This interface keeps all tools **accessible, organized, and easy to configure**.

---

# **Features**

## **Barrier Visualizer**

Highlights **barriers** around the player.

**Features**

* Adjustable radius
* Visual overlay for restricted areas
* Helpful for server spawn zones and protected regions

---

## **Auto Smelt**

Automates common furnace workflows.

**Benefits**

* Quickly takes out items from furnaces within the player's reach

---

## **Mass Cut (`/g2masscut`)**

Improves **stonecutter workflows**.

**Features**

* Set preferred **input and output items**
* Includes **"set held item" shortcuts**
* Faster batch cutting

---

## **Simple Reply (`/r`)**

Adds quick DM reply functionality.

Tracks the last message sender from:

* `/msg`
* `/w`
* `/tell`

Allows instant replies using `/r` instead of `/minecraft:msg username message` since vanilla minecraft does not have a reply feature and some servers simply don't want to add plugins for it.

---

## **PayAll (`/g2payall`)**

Creates **payment batches to online players**.

**Features**

* Manage player lists
* Configure delays
* Use payment templates
* Choose **per-player or total amount handling**
* Quickly message every player

---

## **AutoShop (`/g2shop`)**

Runs **saved buy/sell shop profiles automatically**.

**Features**

* Simple **start / stop commands**
* Supports automated trading flows

---

## **Inventory Macros (`/g2macro`)**

Save and execute **repeating inventory actions**.

**Features**

* Multiple macro profiles
* Fast start/stop controls
* Ideal for repetitive commands and the lack of more keyboard shortcuts

---

## **Chest Sort / G2Chest (`/g2chest`)**

Advanced container management.

**Capabilities**

* Assign containers to specific items
* Deposit matching items automatically
* Retrieve specific item counts
* Clear assignments by:

  * Scope
  * Item
  * Container

**Modes**

* Simple assign mode
* Mass assign mode
* Single assign mode
* **Litematica material support**

---

## **G2Inv (`/g2inv`)**

Inventory snapshot system.

**Features**

* Save full inventory states
* Restore snapshots
* Per-world / per-server scope
* Remove named snapshots

Great for **loadout or kit switching**.

---

## **G2Villager (`/g2villager`)**

Automated **librarian villager rerolling**.

**Features**

* Target specific enchantments
* Multi-target matching (OR logic)
* Level and price limits
* **Legit mode** and **instant mode**
* Command support:

  * help
  * list
  * stop

Perfect for automatically obtaining **desired enchanted books**.

---

## **Hopper Helper (`/g2hopper`)**

Utility for **hopper sorters**.

**Features**

* Quick toggle
* Built-in help command

---

## **Item Drop (`/g2itemdrop`)**

Smart item dropping system.

**Features**

* Whitelist / blacklist behavior
* Full configuration UI
* Useful for automated inventory cleanup

---

## **OG F3 Screen**

Restores the **classic debug overlay style**.

Provides an **old-school F3 layout and information display**.

---

## **Auto Lunge**

Automates attribute swapping with a spear to dash very quickly.

Includes configurable settings.

---

## **Phrase Disconnect**

Monitors chat for a **custom trigger phrase**.

**Features**

* Sender filtering:

  * whitelist
  * blacklist
* Custom message templates:

  * `{user}`
  * `{myUser}`
* Automatic disconnect
* Optional **auto-rejoin after timer**
* Countdown UI with cancel button

* Example phrase "test", example message "test 1m" - you will disconnect and rejoin after 1 minute

---

## **Disable Feedback**

Reduces chat clutter by **suppressing module feedback messages** when enabled.

---

# **Purpose of the Mod**

GUY2 Commands is built as a **personal automation toolkit** for Minecraft players who want to:

* Automate **repetitive gameplay actions**
* Execute commands **faster and smarter**
* Manage inventories and containers efficiently
* Reduce **manual clicking and micromanagement**

Instead of installing many small mods, **GUY2 Commands bundles everything into a single streamlined system.**
